## Pull requests are not accepted

OneTask is a personal project and does not accept pull requests. Please close this PR.

If you'd like to build on OneTask, fork it — the AGPL-3.0 license lets you use, modify, and redistribute it freely (including running it as a network service) as long as you make your modified source available to your users. See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE).

If you found a bug or have a suggestion, opening an **issue** is welcome instead.
